failure_summary: The run-time render_decision offered the OPPONENT's diagonal window c4r1,c3r2,c2r3,c1r4 (and its completing square c1r4) under the handles `you-key-line`/`you-key-square` with the role text "the whole four-in-a-row line YOU are playing for", but on movestring 3113302513454460055 that window holds two Green/opponent discs (c4r1 move 1, c2r3 move 9) and ZERO of the player's Gray discs, so both runs faithfully echoed the false ownership ("your own four-in-a-row line", "keeping your four-in-a-row line as intact as possible") and, having been told c1r4 was their own square rather than the opponent's fork pivot, neither run named c1r4 at all despite it being in the requiredSet.
notes: n_runs is 2 (run_index 0..1), not 5 — no axis was sub-sampled: A3/A4/G2/G4/G5 are graded on both runs because both ARE 'the first 2 runs'. A1/A2/A6 and G7a/G7b_offered copied verbatim from fv_suff_answers_boards_2026-08-06T16-04-29Z_served_mechanical.json (keys eval-42|D|0 and eval-42|D|1, all pass). Graded servedExplanation per the v2 addendum; run 0's raw `c3r2` is served as "column 3, row 2", so no coordinate-notation charge. A5b N/A (boardState=mid-game, not opening). A4 run 0: (i) "your own [windows:c4r1,c3r2,c2r3,c1r4] four-in-a-row line" is board-false — that diagonal is X/Green's (X at c4r1 and c2r3, empties at c3r2 and c1r4, no Gray disc); (ii) "Column 4 lands on the same shared support" is board-false — column 4 lands at c4r5 (per the prompt's own Decision block), while the only shared cell (opponentPunishment.tie.sharedCells) is c1r4 in column 1. A4 run 1: same ownership fabrication, compounded — playing column 1 does not keep that line 'intact', it BLOCKS it by occupying c1r4. A7 run 0: A7b — "the same shared support" is a specific-sounding phrase resolving to nothing on the board and is wrapped in no zone; A7c — the mechanism IS a fork (opponentPunishment.tag=figure_7 / '7-shaped double threat'), the pivot that CREATES it is c1r4 (visualize_board on 311330251345446005530 shows majors at col3 row2 [GT] and col3 row3 for X once the opponent takes c1r4, whereas the after-best board 31133025134544600550 shows only col3 row3 and col3 row5), and c1r4 was OFFERED (alias you-key-square) and even REQUIRED, yet is never named. A7 run 1: A7a — 'gives up that resistance sooner, so your opponent reaches the same forcing idea with less work' restates speed/outcome, not cause; A7b — 'the same forcing idea' points at nothing named; A7c — same unnamed pivot c1r4; A7d — 'meets your opponent's key square in the most resistant way' is abstraction with no idea anchored to squares, and is also directionally wrong (column 1 does not 'meet' c3r2, it removes the c3r2 threat by occupying c1r4). G5 both runs: the offered alias role strings for you-key-square (c1r4) and you-key-line (windows:c4r1,c3r2,c2r3,c1r4) are board-false on their stated truthBoard 'decision' — they assert the player's ownership of a window containing only opponent discs. Not charged: G1 (the model was faithful to the artifact it saw — the artifact carried the error), G4 (every named cell/line is real on render_decision.finalMovestring 311330251345446005530), G6 (patternOnAfterBestBoard=false is correct: after 31133025134544600550 Gray occupies c1r4 and the opponent's diagonal is dead, so L3 realized_denied routes correctly), G7 (annotationRepairs empty, guardDiagnostics clean, every wrap matches its run-time role — line words on the line handle, square words on the square handle). Secondary contributor, not charged: no rendered board ever shows the decisive c3r2 major threat — afterBest/afterPlayed are shown:false as 'tag-set identical to the decision board' (true) and projectedDeep is shown:false because register is 'immediate', so the fork the whole explanation rests on is visible on no board; G3 still passes because c1r4 and the window reach the model through lostResource.completingCell/entryCell/anchorCells, opponentPunishment.tie.sharedCells and the requiredSet. Layer caveat (verify-at-source): the PROMPT rebuilt per Step 0b from TODAY's renderReasonModel.mjs names the same window `opp-key-line` = 'the whole four-in-a-row line your OPPONENT is playing for' and c1r4 as `opp-key-square`, i.e. the ownership mislabel has been FIXED since 2026-08-06 (see the you-key-square/you-key-line comment at renderReasonModel.mjs:619) — so the A4/G5 failures are attributed to the run-time record in the row's own render_decision, NOT to the current prompt, and a re-run today would likely not reproduce them. Production-fidelity caveat: model is gpt-5.4-mini (the shipped model), so no prompt_confusion attribution is made here; the decisive attribution is model-independent (a board-false role string in the offered alias set). OI-183 also applies: the harness calls the model once, so the requiredSet omission of you-key-square that production's retry would trigger on is unexercised here.

Run 0 served 'Column 4 lands on the same shared support'; the played move lands at c4r5 (prompt Decision block) while the sole shared cell is c1r4, in column 1.
